summary:
Implemented the rich_measure feature by reading and editing files only; nothing was run or committed.

Changes:
- rich/tree.py: added Tree.__rich_measure__, an iterative depth-first walk with an explicit stack and level counter. Each label is measured with the unreduced max_width, plus 4 cells per level. Imports Measurement from .measure.
- rich/align.py: Align.__rich_console__ now constrains the wrapped renderable to its measured maximum, or to min(maximum, width) when width is given. Added Align.__repr__. Added VerticalCenter (after Align, before the main guard) with repr, render using console.size.height and newline-segment padding, and measurement passthrough.
- rich/console.py: print's collected-renderable render options use justify="default"; the justify argument still goes to _collect_renderables.
- CHANGELOG.md: 9.8.0 marked unreleased, with an Added subsection (rich_measure for tree; rich.align.VerticalCenter). Existing STDIN entry kept.
- tests/test_align.py: VerticalCenter import, repr test, render test (height 6, expects "\n\nfoo\n\n\n"), measure test (3, 3).
- tests/test_tree.py: Measurement import, tree measurement test expecting Measurement(11, 19).

Not verified: tests were not run, per instructions. The VerticalCenter render expectation assumes print adds no extra newline, which is unconfirmed.
